ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Matter delivery, Awaiting client and later stages need Target end date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Opening", 1, "Cleared to start", 2, "In progress", 3, "Awaiting client", 4, "Final billing", 5, "Closed", 6, 0) >= 4, ISBLANK(Target_end_date__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Target end date before moving to Awaiting client.
